title: Steering Angle Sensor Not Initialized
meaning: ABS / ESC control module has lost steering angle center calibration zero point. Occurs after battery disconnect, front-end alignment, or clockspring service on Jeep Wrangler, Grand Cherokee, Dodge Durango.
symptoms: Electronic Stability Control (ESC) light illuminated
Traction Control off indicator on
ABS light on
inspectionSteps: Verify vehicle wheel alignment is centered (steering wheel straight when driving forward).
Check SAS degrees on scan tool; angle should read 0.0° when wheels are dead ahead.
Inspect clockspring wiring connector.
verifiedFixes: Perform manual lock-to-lock Steering Angle Sensor relearn procedure: Park on level ground, start engine, turn steering wheel smoothly all the way to left lock, hold 2 seconds, turn smoothly all the way to right lock, hold 2 seconds, return to center, drive straight at 15+ MPH for 100 yards.
If relearn fails to store, recalibrate via bi-directional ABS service function or replace steering column clockspring/SAS module.

title: Multiple Cylinder Misfire - Pentastar 3.6L Camshaft / Rocker Arm Needle Bearing Failure
meaning: Crankshaft velocity variations detected cylinder misfire. On Chrysler 3.6L Pentastar engines, needle bearings inside the roller rocker arms collapse, causing the roller to seize and score the camshaft lobe down to a flat profile (Star Online Case S1309000008).
symptoms: Loud, rhythmic metallic ticking noise from cylinder head (especially Bank 1 left side)
Flashing Check Engine Light under acceleration
Rough engine idle and power loss
Misfire codes P0301, P0303, or P0305 stored
inspectionSteps: Remove valve covers and inspect rocker arm roller wheels for radial play and missing needle bearings.
Inspect camshaft lobes for severe scoring, grooving, or flat spots.
Inspect engine oil filter for bronze bearing metallic glitter.
verifiedFixes: Replace worn roller rocker arms and hydraulic lash adjusters (tappets)
Replace scored intake or exhaust camshaft
Complete engine oil and filter change

title: EVAP System Small Leak Detected - ESIM Switch Failure
meaning: Evaporative System Integrity Monitor (ESIM) detected micro-leak (0.020 inch equivalent). On FCA vehicles, the weighted diaphragm and switch contacts inside the ESIM switch housing mounted directly to the charcoal canister fail, preventing vacuum detection.
symptoms: Check Engine Light on
'GASCAP' indicator illuminated in odometer display
Fails state emissions OBD inspection
inspectionSteps: Inspect ESIM (Evaporative System Integrity Monitor) switch mounted on rear charcoal canister.
Verify ESIM switch internal contacts open/close using handheld vacuum pump.
Inspect ESIM rubber seal ring and vapor line connector for dry rot cracks.
verifiedFixes: Replace faulty ESIM (Evaporative System Integrity Monitor) switch assembly
Replace fuel filler cap with genuine OEM cap
Replace cracked charcoal canister housing

title: Engine Oil Pressure Sensor Circuit Malfunction - Pentastar 3.6L
meaning: ECM registered out-of-range voltage on the dual-stage oil pressure sensor circuit. On Chrysler/Dodge/Jeep/Ram 3.6L Pentastar engines, the factory oil pressure sensor mounted under the oil filter adapter housing fails internally, often causing oil leaks into the engine valley (TSB 18-034-14).
symptoms: Illuminated Check Engine Light
Dashboard oil pressure gauge pegged at maximum 99 PSI or dropping to 0 PSI
Oil pooling in the engine 'V' valley under the lower intake manifold
Burning oil odor when engine reaches full operating temperature
inspectionSteps: Inspect the engine valley under the intake manifold with a flashlight for pooled engine oil around the oil filter housing base.
Connect mechanical oil pressure test gauge to verify physical oil pressure (minimum 5 PSI warm idle, 30 PSI at 3000 RPM).
Measure sensor signal voltage with scan tool: 0.5V at 0 PSI, scaling linearly to 4.5V at 100 PSI.
verifiedFixes: Replace faulty engine oil pressure sensor (located on rear of oil filter adapter)
Replace complete plastic oil filter adapter housing assembly with updated aluminum unit if cracked or leaking
Clean harness connector and install new upper/lower intake manifold gaskets

title: Short Runner Valve (SRV) Solenoid Circuit / Performance
meaning: PCM detected the Short Runner Valve actuator failed to reach target open/closed position. Ubiquitous issue on FCA 3.6L Pentastar V6 intake manifold (Grand Cherokee, Durango, Charger, Challenger, Wrangler, Pacifica).
symptoms: Check Engine light illuminated
Loss of top-end horsepower above 4,000 RPM
Buzzing or clicking noise from top of intake manifold when revving engine
inspectionSteps: Inspect the SRV actuator motor located on rear of upper intake manifold.
Check plastic ball-and-socket linkage arm connecting electric actuator to manifold internal runner flap shaft; widely known to pop off or snap due to heat cycling.
Manually move manifold flap shaft with fingers; verify smooth rotation without carbon binding.
verifiedFixes: Snap aftermarket reinforced metal retention clip or replacement linkage arm onto SRV actuator ball stud (avoids replacing entire upper intake manifold).
If internal manifold flaps are gummed with PCV oil residue, remove upper manifold and clean runner flaps with throttle body cleaner.
Replace SRV electric actuator solenoid if internal gears are stripped.

title: Post Catalyst Fuel Trim System Too Lean (Bank 1)
meaning: PCM detected downstream O2 sensor fuel trim correction has reached maximum rich limit. Extremely common on Jeep Wrangler (JK/JL), Dodge Charger, Ram 1500.
symptoms: Check Engine light illuminated
Mild reduction in fuel economy
Hissing or ticking exhaust leak sound on acceleration
inspectionSteps: Inspect exhaust pipe flange welds and catalytic converter ball-and-socket connections upstream of downstream O2 sensor for soot trails or pinhole cracks.
Check exhaust manifold bolts on cylinder head; broken rear exhaust manifold bolts allow cold air to leak into exhaust stream.
Test downstream oxygen sensor heater resistance and voltage response.
Perform smoke test on exhaust system with tailpipe capped.
verifiedFixes: Repair cracked exhaust manifold or replace broken exhaust manifold studs and gaskets.
Tighten or replace leaking exhaust flange clamp upstream of catalytic converter.
Flash PCM with latest FCA powertrain software update (TSB 18-033-14 for false lean threshold tuning).

title: Post Catalyst Fuel Trim System Too Lean (Bank 2)
meaning: Downstream Bank 2 fuel trim indicated lean correction limit reached on FCA 3.6L Pentastar or 5.7L Hemi.
symptoms: Check Engine light illuminated
Exhaust ticking noise on passenger side
inspectionSteps: Inspect Bank 2 exhaust manifold gasket and catalytic converter collector flange for pinhole leaks.
Check Bank 2 downstream O2 sensor pigtail for harness heat damage.
verifiedFixes: Seal Bank 2 exhaust collector flange leak.
Replace Bank 2 downstream oxygen sensor.

title: Lost Communication with ECM - TIPM Fuel Pump Relay Internal Failure
meaning: Modules lost CAN communication frames from the ECM. On Dodge Durango, Grand Cherokee, Ram, and Chrysler minivans, the internal fuel pump relay soldered inside the Totally Integrated Power Module (TIPM) circuit board burns out (NHTSA Recall 14V-530 / TSB 19-001-15).
symptoms: Engine cranks continuously but will not start
Battery drains dead overnight while parked (relay contacts stuck closed)
Vehicle stalls suddenly while driving on highway
Fuel pump continues running after ignition turned off
inspectionSteps: Check for battery voltage at fuel pump connector under rear seat while cranking.
Perform external TIPM fuel pump relay test jumper.
Inspect TIPM multi-pin harness plugs under hood for green corrosion or pushed-out pins.
verifiedFixes: Install external fuel pump relay bypass kit (Chrysler Recall kit CBWPR091AA)
Replace or rebuild Totally Integrated Power Module (TIPM)
Repair loose wiring harness ground under driver kick panel
